idea-plugin.name: SQL Transpiler
idea-plugin.description:
Convert SQL between dialects in DataGrip and IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate. SQL Transpiler uses brikk-sql, a SQLGlot-derived Kotlin transpiler, to parse each statement, generate target-dialect SQL, and report constructs that cannot be translated safely. Supported source and target dialects are MySQL, Doris, Trino, Presto, DuckDB, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Hive, Spark, DataFusion, and BigQuery.

Before Execute via Transpilation runs converted SQL, the plugin runs any available target-parser verification and shows the generated SQL and diagnostics for review. Native parser checks are available for Trino, Doris, and DuckDB; PostgreSQL, MySQL, Hive, and ClickHouse use advisory ShardingSphere 5.5.2 grammar checks. Blocking translation findings and native parser rejections prevent execution. This build includes Trino 484, Doris 4.1.4, and DuckDB 2.0.0.0 verification components. Trino verification requires a Java 25 or newer runtime.

Compatible with DataGrip and IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate 2026.2 through 2026.3 (IDE builds 262 through 263.*), with the bundled Database Tools plugin.

  • Execute via Transpilation. Convert a block from its source dialect to the supported dialect of the attached console, then review and execute the generated SQL. Unchanged, approved conversions skip the dialog but are still reconverted and rechecked. A same-dialect execution scope containing no PIPE syntax runs unchanged, without this conversion and verification pipeline
  • Transpile To / From. Convert a selection, dialect-marker block, or whole file; preview a before/after diff, then replace in place, insert after, copy, or send to an open console
  • Translation diagnostics. Findings cover unmappable functions, unsupported translations, raw passthrough, semantic hazards, and capability gaps. Function capability checks use engine catalogs for Doris, Trino, and DuckDB; other targets report when catalog checks are unavailable
  • Brikk SQL scratches (.bsql). Keep multiple SQL dialects and connections in one file. Each block starts with -- language=dorissql using="Doris prod" (or another IDE SQL language) and has that language's highlighting, completion, and errors. Ordinary blocks run as written on their own connection with Ctrl+Enter
  • PIPE syntax (|>). Desugar pipelines to standard SQL during transpilation. Supported-dialect PIPE blocks in .bsql scratches are also lowered immediately before direct execution, and lowering blockers stop the run. This direct path does not use the Execute via Transpilation review or native-verifier gate; the destination engine parses the SQL it receives
  • AST viewer. Inspect the brikk-sql expression tree in a tool window

An independent plugin by Sortdev SRL, built on the open-source brikk-sql transpiler.

Source, issues, and documentation: github.com/sort-dev/sql-transpiler-intellij-plugin
